name: bague-memory
description: Recall and save the rules, decisions and preferences you keep in BAGUE Memory.

interface.longDescription:
BAGUE Memory is a shared, long-term memory for the AI tools you use at work. Instead of explaining your business, your rules and your past decisions again in every chat, you save them once in BAGUE Memory, and they can be recalled when they are needed.

What it does:
- Recall memory (read-only): when your question depends on something you saved before, such as opening hours, prices, how you write to customers or decisions you made, it looks this up in your BAGUE Memory.
- Save memory: when you say "remember this", it saves the text to your BAGUE Memory, so it is there next time.

Your memory is kept in BAGUE Memory and can also be used from the BAGUE Memory browser extension. Only the words sent to the tool are received, never your whole conversation. Memories cannot be deleted or edited from here; that is done in BAGUE Memory itself.

Requirements: a BAGUE Memory account (sign in with your BAGUE Memory email). Made by BAGUE Inc. in Japan. Memories can be written in Japanese or English.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about our return policy?
Save this to BAGUE Memory: our staff meeting is every Monday at 9am.

positive.prompt: Check BAGUE Memory: What day is Mihon Shoten closed?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers Wednesday, from the saved memory of the sample shop Mihon Shoten.

positive.prompt: Check BAGUE Memory: How much is the Seasonal Baked Goods Set?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 3,240 yen including tax, from the saved memory.

positive.prompt: Check BAGUE Memory: What is Mihon Shoten's return policy?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that only unopened items are accepted, within 7 days of delivery.

positive.prompt: Check BAGUE Memory: Who supplies Mihon Shoten's flour?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers Yamada Flour Mill, ordered on the first Monday of every month.

positive.description: Save a new memory and recall it in a new chat
positive.prompt: Save this to BAGUE Memory: our staff meeting is every Monday at 9am. (Then, in a new chat: Check BAGUE Memory: when is our staff meeting?)
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the memory was saved; in a new chat, answers Monday at 9am from the saved memory.

negative.description: General question unrelated to saved memories
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: Coding task unrelated to saved memories
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported; nothing is deleted
negative.prompt: Delete all my memories in BAGUE Memory.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: recall memories saved in BAGUE Memory and save new ones.

ja-JP.subtitle: 仕事の記憶を、どのAIでも
ja-JP.description:
BAGUE Memory は、仕事で使う AI のための、共通の長期の記憶です。会社のこと、決まり、これまでに決めたことを一度保存しておけば、必要なときに思い出せます。

できること：
- 記憶を思い出す（読み取りのみ）：前に保存したこと（営業時間、価格、お客さまへのメールの書き方、決めたことなど）を BAGUE Memory から調べます。
- 記憶に保存する：「覚えておいて」と頼むと、BAGUE Memory に保存します。

記憶は BAGUE Memory に置かれ、BAGUE Memory の拡張機能からも使えます。受け取るのは道具に渡された言葉だけで、会話の全部は受け取りません。記憶の削除や書き換えは、ここからはできません。

必要なもの：BAGUE Memory のアカウント（BAGUE Memory のメールアドレスでログイン）。提供：株式会社BAGUE（日本）。
